exposure: OPRM1, COMT, and ABCB1 genetic variability

Twenty single nucleotide polymorphisms in 14 genes involved in glial activation (TLR2, TLR4, MYD88, MD2), inflammatory signalling (IL2, IL6, IL10, IL1B, IL6R, TNFA, TGFB1, CRP, CASP1), and neuronal regulation (BDNF)
Genetic variability in innate immune signalling pathways
outcome: Variability in morphine dosage after elective caesarean section
cohort: 133 Indian, 230 Malay, and 598 Han Chinese women who underwent elective caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia
finding: Ethnicity, OPRM1 rs1799971, TLR2 rs3804100, and an interaction between ethnicity and IL1B rs1143634 predicted 9.8% of variability in morphine use scores after elective caesarean section.
